lead.headline: The week is gone; claim Loveland — and Golden missed Monday's estimate
lead.deck: You trail 119.76 to 81.82 with only Pickens left; ESPN gives you 1%. The claim clears Wednesday 01:00. Green Bay play Thursday.
lead.body: Start with the bad news: Isaiah Likely caught two passes for 12 in McCarthy's first Giants start, Garrett Wilson had 4.6 on three targets, the Jets D/ST scored 1, and Furia Regia lead 119.76 to 81.82 with only Pickens — cleared, no designation — left tonight. New this afternoon: Matthew Golden was a DNP on the Packers' estimated Monday report (shoulder and foot) for Thursday's game against Carolina; it was a no-practice day, so Tuesday and Wednesday decide it. Josh Jacobs was not listed. The week's real decision has not changed: Kmet's season is over, Likely's Giants are on bye in Week 8, and Colston Loveland is still on waivers — claim him and drop C.J. Stroud, whose bye-cover job is done.

doFirst.deck: Loveland for Stroud. When the week rolls, Daniels back at quarterback.
doFirst.note: Loveland costs your waiver priority (5th, never resets) — the one kind of claim it should buy. Mayer is the free-agent fallback. Thursday's Packers (Jacobs, Golden) lock first in Week 8.
doFirst.empty: Nothing else to do; only Pickens is unlocked and he starts.
